_README: Hand-keyed band ground truth for the four multi-view page-pairs of the 2026-08-18
fixture (testset/skewset_*, testset/skewset_manifest.json). This is the GT the
pre-registration docs/plans/multiview-phase1-prereg.md says must be keyed before its
ONE scoring run. Committed in its own commit, BEFORE that run, so git history shows
the reference text predates the numbers -- the same reason the pre-registration itself
was committed before a single token was keyed.
WHAT IT IS KEYED ON. The UVDoc-dewarped ANCHOR (face-on) frame of each set, prepared
exactly as temp/mv_phase1b/prep.py prepares it: orientation pinned per set, the
HAND-READ page crop from the manifest, UVDoc dewarp. Those .png files are frozen --
keyed off them, scored off them, never regenerated in between.
BAND DEFINITION -- reused verbatim from temp/mv_phase1/gt_far.json, not re-derived, so
the replication of the N=3 numbers stays readable. The text COLUMN's own coordinates
(column edges = 2nd/98th percentile of the anchor's OCR word boxes), band = [.12-.24]
of the column width measured inward from an edge. GUTTER takes the spine-side edge,
FAR takes the outer one; which is which comes from the manifest's target_page, and was
confirmed by eye on <tag>_bands_thumb.png before keying (gutter red, far blue). Band
geometry, in pixels and page fractions: temp/mv_phase1b/band_geometry.json.
KEYING RULE: a word is keyed when its CENTRE falls between the red lines drawn on the
full-res <tag>_{gut,far}_NN.png chunks -- the same rule both earlier band GTs use.
Words straddling an edge are a judgement call. Recall is scored FULL-PAGE, so a
band-membership slip is harmless: the metric asks 'did this arm recover this printed
word', not 'did it put the word in this band'.
THE ANCHOR-PRIMARY RULE, fixed before keying (this is the one that could bend a
result). The gutter GT is keyed on the anchor, which is BY CONSTRUCTION the worse
reader in that band -- that is what makes the band interesting. So a word the anchor's
photo renders illegible would never enter GT, and those are exactly the words the merge
exists to recover: the win would be deflated for a KEYING reason, invisibly. Rule:
key anchor-primary (like-for-like with the original three pages); where a word cannot
be resolved from the anchor strip alone, resolve it against the CANDIDATE strip
(<tag>_obl_NN.png, dumped for this purpose) and list it under `gutter_assisted`. The
pre-registered verdict is scored on `gutter` alone; `gutter_assisted` is a labelled
exploratory diagnostic, never folded into the verdict.
OBSERVATION WORTH RECORDING, made while keying and NOT acted on: on these four pages
the anchor is largely legible inside the [.12-.24] ring, because that ring sits one
band-width IN from the column edge -- the badly compressed text is in the innermost
[0-.12] strip, which this band definition excludes by design (it excluded it on the
original three too). The band was NOT widened to chase the smear: changing it here
would destroy the like-for-like replication that is the point of the fixture. It is
reported instead as a stated limit on what A1 can show.
COVERAGE, declared per page below in `_coverage`. Running headers and page numbers are
excluded, as in both earlier band GTs. Footnote / reference blocks ARE keyed where
legible, and flagged in `_coverage`, because they are printed text in the band and both
arms are charged for them equally.

en_01._coverage: gut chunks 00-03 (body 00-02, reference block 03), far chunks 00-03 (body 00-02, reference block 03). Section title 'What Are Chopmarks?' and the running header excluded. Anchor legible throughout both bands: gutter_assisted is EMPTY, checked against en_01_obl_01.png.

en_02._coverage: gut chunks 00-03 (body 00-03, reference block in 03), far chunks 00-03 (body 00-03, reference block in 03). Running header 'Chopmarked Coins by Nationality' and the 'Description:' sub-head excluded. Indented block-quote lines ARE keyed. Anchor legible throughout both bands: gutter_assisted is EMPTY, checked against en_02_obl_02.png.

it_01._coverage: gut chunks 00-03 (04 is blank paper), far chunks 00-03 (04 holds only the page number '62'). The green title banner 'GALLERIA GOIGINGER E SENTIERO ATTREZZATO AL SASSO DI STRIA' is excluded, as section titles are on en_01; the red info-box headings (IN SALITA, COMPLESSIVO, ...) ARE keyed, being body text of the info box. One word in gut_00 -- the word following 'facilmente' on the first body line -- is unreadable on BOTH frames (the crop cuts into it) and was skipped. gutter_assisted holds ONE token: the place name 'Pocol', which the anchor renders as 'Podol' and only the candidate resolves.

de_01._coverage: gut chunks 01-03 (00 is the orange title banner + photo, 04 is blank), far chunks 01-02 (00 is banner + photo, 03 is a photo whose caption is cut across the chunk edge and mostly out of band, 04 holds only the publisher footer 'alpinverlag.at', out of band). The orange title banner 'Arzalpenturm-Klettersteig / Sextener Dolomiten' is excluded as a page header. Photo CAPTIONS are keyed where they cross the band ('Tolles Bergpanorama beim Ausstieg', 'im Abstieg an der Rueckseite des Turms'). This page is figure-heavy with a single prose block, so both bands are small -- 14 and 15 entries against 47-52 on the English pages. That is the declared control's nature, not a keying shortfall, and it is why A3's +-0.05 window here is worth about one token. Anchor legible throughout: gutter_assisted is EMPTY, checked against de_01_obl_02.png.
